items.q: What does a website or automation cost?
items.a: It depends on the scope — a lean landing page is a different story than a multi-page website with connected workflows. Instead of off-the-shelf packages, we quote fairly and transparently, tailored to what you actually need. The first assessment is free and without obligation.

items.q: How long does it take until the site is live?
items.a: Most websites go live within a few weeks — depending on the scope and how quickly content and approvals come from you. Thanks to our six clear phases, you always know where your project stands.

Not necessarily — and we won't talk you into it. But if you keep doing the same manual steps (sorting enquiries, confirming appointments, moving data around), automation quickly saves noticeable time. We take an honest look at whether and where it pays off for you.

items.q: Do you handle domain and hosting too?
items.a: Yes. On request we take care of domain registration, hosting setup and search engine registration — and explain what's behind it. You don't have to deal with anything technical.

items.q: I already have a website. Can you work with it?
items.a: Usually, yes. Whether it's a revamp, a relaunch or adding automation — we look at where you stand today and recommend the most sensible path instead of rebuilding everything by default.

Domain and hosting come with small recurring costs — that's true for any website. Beyond that, it's your call: many clients maintain their site themselves, others book us for upkeep and further development. We tell you upfront what to expect.
We build data-minimal by design: local fonts instead of Google Fonts, no tracking, no unnecessary cookies. That's not just GDPR-friendly — it's also faster and more respectful of your visitors.

process.title: How We Work – Your Website in 6 Steps | Operiva
process.description: Our process in six clear phases: from briefing to go-live. Transparent, predictable and jargon-free.
process.intro: Commissioning a website shouldn't feel like a leap into the unknown. That's why we work in six clear phases — you always know what's happening and what comes next.

steps.label: Phase 1
steps.title: Briefing & requirements
steps.text: We get to know your business: what you offer, who you want to reach and what the website should achieve. The result is a clear picture.

steps.label: Phase 2
steps.title: Content & assets
steps.text: Logo, images, existing copy — we gather everything you have. Whatever's missing, we design or write for you.

steps.label: Phase 3
steps.title: Copy & structure
steps.text: We build the site structure and write all the copy: clear, persuasive and optimised for Google. You approve it.

steps.label: Phase 4
steps.title: Design & build
steps.text: Structure and copy become a real website. Custom-designed, responsive, technically clean — page by page.

steps.label: Phase 5
steps.title: Review & polish
steps.text: You review everything at your own pace. We implement your change requests until it's right.

steps.label: Phase 6
steps.title: Go-Live
steps.text: Domain, hosting, search engine registration — we get your site safely online and explain everything you need to know.

cta.text: Sounds good? Then let's start with Phase 1.

about.title: About – The Idea Behind Operiva | Operiva
about.description: Operiva combines web design and automation. Learn how we work and what we stand for.
paragraphs: Operiva grew from a simple conviction: a good website is just the beginning. The real leverage lies in what happens next — when enquiries are handled automatically, appointments coordinate themselves and processes run in the background.

We combine the two: thoughtful web design and intelligent automation. For you, that means one point of contact instead of many, clear processes instead of endless back-and-forth, and solutions that genuinely fit your business.

“A&D — Automations & Designs” reflects our standard: carefully crafted, technically precise, with an eye for detail. Whether you're a trades business, a practice or a growing company — we work as equals and explain rather than confuse.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Operiva
privacy.description: Privacy policy of the Operiva web agency pursuant to the GDPR.
privacy.intro: We take the protection of your personal data seriously and treat it confidentially and in accordance with statutory regulations. This policy explains which data we process when you visit this website, for what purpose and on what legal basis.
privacy.warning: This privacy policy contains placeholders (e.g. hosting provider, contact details). It must be completed with the actual information and legally reviewed before go-live.

sections.title: 1. Controller
paragraphs: The controller responsible for processing personal data on this website is the provider named in the imprint. Please refer to our imprint for the full contact details.

sections.title: 2. Hosting
paragraphs: This website is hosted by an external service provider ([hosting provider, address]). Any data collected in this context is processed on the provider's servers. The basis is our legitimate interest in providing our website securely and reliably (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). A data processing agreement (Art. 28 GDPR) is in place with the provider.

sections.title: 3. Server log files
paragraphs: When you access this website, the hosting provider automatically collects information in so-called server log files that your browser transmits: browser type and version, operating system used, referrer URL, hostname of the accessing device, time of the server request and the IP address.
This data is not merged with other data sources. Processing is based on Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR for the technical provision and security of the website. The log files are deleted after a short period.

sections.title: 4. Contact form
paragraphs: When you send us an enquiry via the contact form, your details (name, email address, company where applicable, subject and message) are stored in order to process the enquiry and in case of follow-up questions.

The form is sent via the Formspree service (Formspree, Inc., USA). The data you enter is transmitted to Formspree and processed there. This constitutes a transfer to a third country (USA); it is based on appropriate safeguards (EU standard contractual clauses).

The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) as well as our legitimate interest in answering your enquiry or the initiation of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR). You may withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future.

sections.title: 5. Fonts (self-hosted)
paragraphs: This website uses only locally embedded fonts. There is no connection to third-party servers (e.g. Google Fonts); your IP address is not transmitted to third parties.

sections.title: 6. Cookies & tracking
paragraphs: This website does not use tracking or analytics cookies and does not embed any third-party advertising or analytics services. No user tracking takes place.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: Within the framework of the applicable statutory provisions, you have the following rights at any time:
items: Access to the data stored about you (Art. 15 GDPR)
Withdrawal of consent with effect for the future
Lodging a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR)

sections.title: 8. Currency of this policy
paragraphs: This privacy policy will be updated as soon as the legal situation or the services used on this website change.
